example_media.why_it_works: Pink beanie + pink hair monochrome aesthetic is a high-engagement Pinterest/IG trope. Goggle-prop adds 'just-came-down-from-the-slopes' authenticity. Dark wood chalet backdrop creates strong contrast with subject. Premium ski-luxe location signals wealth.

clusters.name: Tropical Villa — Full Body
clusters.description: Modelo em tropical villa, framing full body.

example_media.pose_archetype: lounging-on-outdoor-sofa, seated reclined with right knee bent up against chest, left leg folded under, right hand resting on chin/jaw, body tilted slightly to right
example_media.why_it_works: Classic bikini-on-villa-sofa shot performs reliably. Pink-and-black bikini matches signature pink hair palette. Negative space and cream wall make it feed-friendly. Sunglasses + finger-on-chin = effortless cool factor.

clusters.name: Pool — Medium
clusters.description: Modelo em pool, framing medium.

example_media.pose_archetype: lounging-on-rattan-armchair, seated upright with hands resting on opposite forearms in lap, body slightly leaned back, head tilted very slightly down, sunglasses on
example_media.why_it_works: Classic vacation flex — pool + rattan + bikini + abs. Paired with previous shot creates carousel narrative ('day in my life at the villa').

clusters.name: Street Urban — Close Up
clusters.description: Modelo em street urban, framing close up.

example_media.pose_archetype: tilted-overhead-selfie shot at ~45° dutch-angle, head tipped to camera-left, shoulders rotated 3/4, arm extended up holding phone (out of frame)
example_media.primary_hook: luxury-flex selfie (head-to-toe Prada with iconic triangle logos visible)
example_media.why_it_works: Three Prada triangle logos in one frame (jacket plate, knit logo, bag plate) is a deliberate brand stack. Dutch angle adds movement/energy to a static selfie. Pink hair against pure black wardrobe = strong color contrast that pops in feed.
